QuestInfo.name: The New Master's Decision
QuestInfo.0: Return to the Xuanshan School and talk to Xiao Xiao.
QuestInfo.2:
The Cygnus Knights visited the Xuanshan School. Xiao Xiao voiced her disappointment about how you unilaterally decided to join the Alliance without discussing it first. 
She said that everyone, even the young pupils, do their best to walk beside you and asked you not to shoulder burdens yourself.
